notes.title: Red Impact DEMO out now!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We are super excited to release a demo for Red Impact.
This little project began has a small game jam. We have always thought about massive planet-to-space battles and how that could translate to a game.

[previewyoutube=GGxLv2P8WEY;full][/previewyoutube]

Red Impact is about defending planets from waves of incoming invaders by annihilating them into dust.
In order to build your massive planetary weapons you'll first need to build resource extractors that generate material or energy. As waves progress you'll face more and more enemy ships, so use your space wisely, upgrade and beat your friends highscores.

In this demo, the first planet (its not a moon) is playable with 5 missions (including a skippable tutorial), a number of unlockables and the endless mode which competes on a leaderboard for score.

You can [b]play the DEMO[/b] right now on Steam or chat with us the Discord.
